evals.prompt: This repo feels stuck. What's the single highest-leverage change I should make right now?
evals.expected_output: Agent scans the repo, enumerates 3-7 small candidates, ranks by impact/effort, picks exactly one genuinely-small move, implements it, and verifies. No large plan, no feature backlog dump.
Triggers the skill and runs the single-move workflow end to end (scan -> pick -> ship -> verify), not a multi-feature roadmap.

evals.prompt: Run the next best thing 4 times.
evals.expected_output: Treats '4 times' as explicit opt-in loop count; runs the full 5-step workflow 4 times, re-scanning each pass, one move per iteration, stopping early only on failure/clean-repo/user-stop.
